key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنُ: The Beneficent, a name of God denoting vast mercy

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Ar-Rahman in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Ar-Rahman' is not merely a title but a profound theological concept denoting God's all-encompassing, universal mercy that precedes His specific judgment. This attribute underscores the divine benevolence extended to all creation, reflecting the Shia emphasis on God's grace as the foundation of existence and the catalyst for human return to Him.
